accuracy_line.rule: D-177: the share within x1.5 and the median |log(realised / predicted)| over ALL cells. A cell whose ratio is not finite and positive IS A MISS (D-322 (4), as src/phase3_a1.py's `accuracy` and src/mlp_probe_d383.py's `accuracy_line` count one): an infinite error, OUTSIDE x1.5 and INSIDE the median, so the registered 80% threshold means what it says. A non-finite cell, and a cell whose realised shift has the OPPOSITE SIGN to c * sigma (a negative ratio), are both misses by this rule. The median is None with median_is_a_miss when it falls on a miss; the same line over the usable cells only is reported beside, never instead

implementation_choices.rule: D-181: the choice nearest D-entry decides; the list is recorded, not cited

choices.a: THE CANARY CATEGORY of an H row is a2_p3.category_rows applied to the rows of the v1 pool4d file at the sha256 the v2 record names (sets['v2']['v1_files']['pool4d'], the file a1m_p3.v2_rows_by_set reads for pool4d_pos and the one the H caches were extracted from; the v2 record's own check says the positives are unchanged in v2), keyed by the stored item_ids|pool4d_pos, so the mask is over the H matrix's own rows. The file's positives must be exactly those 1,000 ids (as a set; whether also in the same order is recorded) and labelled 1. The counts must be 99 / 71 / 47 for cat-1 / cat-2 / cat-3, or the module refuses.
choices.b: THE ATTACK'S TRAINING PROMPTS are the item_ids array of each of the 30 A2 train records' _arrays.npz (sha256- checked against the pull manifest and against the npz its record names), whose sha256 over '\n'.join(ids) must equal the record's training_prompts.item_ids_sha256; the 30 must be one list, and the 6 A2 lambda records' training_prompts.item_ids_sha256 must be that list's too (the lambda scans trained on the same prompts). The canaries must be disjoint from ALL of them (harmful and unharmful, shifted or zero-shift), not only from the target category's shifted subset.
choices.c: THE FALL is computed from the integer hit counts of a2_p3.hit_counts (>=): fall_k(d) = 100 x sum_j (n_pre,kdj - n_X,kdj) / (n_k x J), one float division of an exact integer, which is the seed mean of the per-seed TPR differences in points.
choices.d: THE MATCHED tau: candidates are nextafter(v, +inf) for every clean statistic value v (no registered cut exists for this statistic, so none is a candidate); counts are compared as integers; the record says whether the achieved count EQUALS G or is the LARGEST ACHIEVABLE BELOW it, with the rate count / 603. G is the global check's clean false-alarm count from defence_d1_d442.global_pass on the three clean seeds' pool scores, computed here (no D1 output is read).
choices.e: Every false-alarm rate and every 'share of the draws' is over all 201 rows (the frozen split included), as the 603 = 3 x 201 states; the share over the 200 re-partitions alone (rows 1:) is recorded beside. 'Fires on the frozen split' is row 0.
choices.f: P-D2e.3's CELL SET (D-444, by D-181) is P-A2.3's OWN TWO-ARM MEASURE: the c = -2 cells whose D-440 verdicts- record row has falls_exact.frozen AND falls_exact.R_same true (P-A2.3's n_falling; its exact D-156 fields, cross-checked against the score record's category.arms.<arm>.fall_points_exact.falls). Two of the registered text's three descriptors ('P-A2.3's own measure', '8 of the 15 cells') name that set; the third ('at the frozen threshold') alone would give 9 on the stored records (one cell falls at the frozen T but not at R_same). The frozen-only reading's set and verdict are recorded BESIDE, never instead. An empty set FAILS (never vacuously HELD).
choices.g: THE DESCRIPTIVE canary fall of a cell is the D-156 mean over the re-partitions (rows 1:) of the target category's fall_k (pre - attacked, the check's own quantity), the frozen split beside; the like-for-like fall (clean seed 0 - attacked, A2's own baseline) is recorded beside with its own accuracy line. The evaluation fall is the score record's category.arms.frozen.fall_points_exact.fall_points (the D-156 mean P-A2.3 decides on). Ratio = canary / evaluation fall (a1m_p3._ratio_or_nan); the D-177 line (a1m_p3.accuracy_line) over the cells whose FROZEN-arm evaluation fall is at least 10 points (falls_exact.frozen, the arm whose fall is compared; not P-D2e.3's two-arm set), over all 30 cells.
choices.h: DETECTION SPLIT BY TARGET: for every statistic (the max and each category's own) the cells of each target category (cat-1, cat-2, cat-3, 10 each); for cat-k's own statistic the 20 cells NOT targeting cat-k beside.
choices.i: PRIMARY and BESIDE are defence_d1_d442.primary_sets's (the 3 successful cat-3 c = -2 cells; the 5 successful cells).
choices.j: Every A2 record and npz this module reads (score, train, lambda, categories, verdicts) is checked against the two pull manifests (defence_d1_d442.checked) and refuses if absent or different.
choices.k: A3 is bit for bit in `run`; `check` takes --max-ulp for a machine whose numpy / scipy differ from the node's (D1's choice (n)); the flags must still be equal.
choices.l: The npz stores the canary masks and ids, clean seeds 1 and 2's pool and H score matrices and item ids (not stored by any A2 record; this module reads no D1 output), the per-side, per-category hit counts, every fall and statistic array, the global flags and the fires; row 0 of every per-draw array is the frozen split.
choices.m: Status FINAL only at the registered parameters (30 cells, probe seeds 0-4, 201 draws, cut (2.0, 0.5), the 6-thread BLAS pin); otherwise PROVISIONAL. The per-category statistics, the splits and the canary-against- evaluation fall are DESCRIPTIVE.
choices.n: `check` reads the v2 record through selection_tpr_v2.read_v2 with a code block that allows no commit (it writes nothing), so it needs the v2 calibration, v1 pool4d and v1 probe_train split files on disk. It prints ONLY the inputs, the anchors, the canary counts, the disjointness and choice (r)'s overlaps: nothing that previews a result. Earlier versions (6bd4704, b658b15) also printed clean seed 0's global false-alarm count, the count of cells whose frozen-split max statistic exceeded clean seed 0's largest value and the primary cells' frozen-split statistics; that sighting is recorded in D-444.
choices.o: P-D2e.1 is decided before anything is written: a failed part refuses, so a written record carries it HELD with each part's numbers.
choices.p: The matched tau refuses when the global clean count G is at least the number of clean comparisons (603): every count is then achievable and the matching is void (defence_d1_d442's choice (v)).
choices.q: THE CLEAN-SEED CONFOUND (DESCRIPTIVE, no verdict): every attacked model sits on clean seed 0, so its canary scores carry clean seed 0's own shift, while tau is matched on seeds 0, 1 and 2 together and the fall is read against pre, not against the clean arm the attack sits on. A clean seed 0 whose canary TPR moves differently from seeds 1 and 2 moves every attacked cell's statistic together, and three clean seeds estimate the clean spread poorly. Recorded beside, never instead: per clean seed the largest value of each statistic over its 201 draws; the tau the same rule (choice (d), with G the global count of those seeds' own comparisons) gives from clean seed 0 alone (201) and from seeds 1 and 2 alone (402), each with the frozen-split fires it would give in the registered groups. A subset whose G is not below its comparisons is recorded void, not refused.
choices.r: The canaries' overlap with the v1 probe_train items (the frozen file the v2 record names) and with the v2 calibration items (item_ids|calibration) is RECORDED beside the disjointness block, never refused: the spec does not register it.

npz.rule: cell|<cat-k>|c=<c>|as<seed>|... per cell; clean<s>|... per clean seed; stat|max is the registered statistic; row 0 of every per-draw array is the frozen split
